### Breaking Down Walls
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-sept-11-2008-11581643.html
Passage: Esther 8:15-17
Points:
- The widespread rejoicing in Susa shows that seemingly impenetrable darkness and despair do not last forever.
- The ancient deliverance recorded in Esther remains directly relevant for people facing hostility, deep grief, or oppression today.
- God specializes in tearing down formidable walls, offering genuine hope even when the timing of relief is unknown.
- Believers can take heart that present seasons of weeping will ultimately yield to God's light and joy.
